title: Congestion Lattice
tagline: Compare queue management strategies that trade latency, fairness, and throughput under bursty load.

curves.label: FIFO Tail Drop
curves.code: queue=[]; for(p=0;p<n;p++){ queue.push(p); if(queue.length>64){ queue.shift(); } } delay = queue.length * 0.25;
curves.name: FIFO Tail Drop

curves.label: RED Probabilistic Drop
curves.code: for(p=0;p<n;p++){ if(queue.length>20){ dropProb = Math.min(0.5,(queue.length-20)/50); if(Math.random()<dropProb){ /*drop*/ } else { queue.push(p); } } else queue.push(p); } delay = queue.length * 0.18 + 5;
curves.name: RED Probabilistic Drop

curves.label: CoDel Control
curves.code: target=5; interval=100; sojourn=0; for(p=0;p<n;p++){ sojourn = 3 + 0.02*p + (queue.length*0.01); queue.push(p); if(sojourn>target){ /*enter control*/ } while(queue.length>80) queue.shift(); } delay = 5 + 0.8*queue.length*0.05 + 3*Math.log10(n+10);
curves.name: CoDel Control

curves.label: WFQ Virtual Finish
curves.code: weights=[2,1,1,3]; for(p=0;p<n;p++){ flow=p%4; invW=1/weights[flow]; vtime = (lastV[flow]||0) + invW; finish = vtime + 1*invW; heapPush(flow,finish); } /*serve in finish order*/ delay = 6 + (n*Math.log2(n+1))*0.25;
curves.name: WFQ Virtual Finish

curves.label: BRR Burst Repair
curves.code: budget=45; used=0; for(p=0;p<n;p++){ if(used>=budget){ /*repair step*/ used=0; } used += 1; queue.push(p); if(queue.length>70) queue.shift(); } delay = 4 + 90*Math.pow(n/(n+45),2);
curves.name: BRR Burst Repair
